entities.summary: The Al-Istiqamah Mosque, known locally as Masjid Al-Istiqamah, is a mosque in Serangoon, Singapore which was completed in 1999. It is located in the estate of Serangoon North, at the corner of Yio Chu Kang Road and Ang Mo Kio Avenue 3; the front entrance is located along Serangoon North Avenue 2.
